text:
lucy: Seeing intermittent SSL verify failures on Windows when running the Python SDK AsyncClient (3.8-3.12). Sometimes followed by "TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable" in our retry code. Anyone hit that?

marc: Stack (trimmed):
```
ssl.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed
...
File "redwood_sdk/async_client.py", line 140, in _request
  for h in resp.headers:
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable
```
jen: Likely two issues: (1) async path not loading certifi bundle on Windows; (2) retry wrapper returns None on error path. Workaround: pip install certifi and set SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where().

lucy: Repro: clean venv, python.org 3.11 on Win10, pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.3 + aiohttp. Fails ~20% runs.

marc: Plan: add certifi.load in async client bootstrap for Windows/missing cafile; fix retry to always raise a unified error instead of returning None; add pyi stubs for AsyncClient to improve typing across 3.8-3.12.

jen: I'll add a small examples/windows script that sets SSL_CERT_FILE if missing and file an issue with repro.

devex-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2470

ci-bot: CI matrix request: run typing checks on 3.8/3.9/3.10/3.11/3.12 (Windows) to catch regressions.

lucy: Thanks team — will update examples and request a patch release once fixes land.
